title: Goods intake: create a batch of assets on one invoice
interface: class IntakeService(assets: AssetService, invoices: InvoiceRepository, audit: AuditRepository). create_batch(actor, type, brand, model, quantity: int, invoice_number: str, supplier: str, unit_price, location_id, tag_names: list[str], warranty_until: str, condition='new') -> dict {'invoice': invoice dict or None, 'assets': [asset dicts]}: quantity must be 1..500 else ValueError; invoice: when invoice_number given -> get_by_number or create(number, supplier, issued_at='', total=quantity*unit_price, currency='CZK', notes='', created_by=actor); assets created one by one with assets.create(actor, asset_tag='', type=..., brand, model, serial_number='', purchase_date='', price=unit_price, notes='', location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, invoice_id, tag_names); audit 'intake.batch' with quantity and asset ids. set_serials(actor, serials: dict[int, str]) -> int: assets.update(actor, asset_id, serial_number=value) for each non-empty value; returns count.
